contradictions.source: cōpertoq́; deinde uim magicam cingulo insertam, eam ob causam uxorem repudiauit.
contradictions.english: Once the magic power inserted into the belt was not discovered, he repudiated his wife for that reason.
contradictions.why: The English adds 'not', reversing the meaning that he repudiated her because the magic was discovered.
